purpose: Explicit 0 PULSE edges, width and period take the .tran defaults

oracle.derivation: ngspice-44.2 run of this deck; values match the closed form in the deck header.
oracle.command: ngspice-45 -b (meas tran find v(a) at the axis times); values are the closed form in the deck header
oracle.confirmed_reason: Explicit zero TR, TF, PW and PER: ngspice (as Berkeley SPICE3 vsrcload.c) reads each 0 as its default (TSTEP, TSTOP), giving 0.5, 1, 1; Xyce 7.10.0 reads them literally (a zero-width pulse, v = 0). The ngspice-45 manual 4.1.1 gives defaults only for omitted fields, so no documented rule decides between them.
